name: fullstack-agents
description: Unified fullstack development toolkit with 29 AI agents, 8 commands, and 25 skill domains for FastAPI, Rust/Axum, Next.js, Docker, Celery, WebSocket, and more. Polyglot microservices with strict Python/Rust language-lane separation, clean architecture + DDD in both languages, wire-contract parity behind one Next.js frontend, and spec-kit-compatible project constitutions with constitution-aware gates. Auto-triggers via SessionStart hook with hard enforcement hooks (prompt re-arming, pre-edit blocking, post-edit and stop validation) and a senior-engineer discipline for duplication prevention.
